questions.question: If the equations $x^2 - 8x + 7 = 0$ and $x^2 - 9x + k = 0$ in Coordinate Geometry (Straight Lines & Circles) (Family of Circles & Radical Axis) share the common root $x = 1$, find the value of $k$.
questions.solution: Substituting the common root $x = 1$ into the second equation gives $1 - (9) + k = 0 \implies k = 8$.
questions.explanation: Apply common roots & parameter elimination techniques in Coordinate Geometry (Straight Lines & Circles) (Family of Circles & Radical Axis).

questions.question: Two quadratic equations $2x^2 + 16x + 18 = 0$ and $x^2 + p x + q = 0$ in Coordinate Geometry (Straight Lines & Circles) (Image of Point & Orthocenter) have both roots in common. Find $p + q$.
questions.solution: Proportionality of coefficients $\frac{1}{2} = \frac{p}{16} = \frac{q}{18} \implies p = 8,\; q = 9 \implies p + q = 17$.
questions.explanation: Apply common roots & parameter elimination techniques in Coordinate Geometry (Straight Lines & Circles) (Image of Point & Orthocenter).

questions.question: In Coordinate Geometry (Straight Lines & Circles) (Director Circle & Chord of Contact), find the largest integral value of parameter $m$ for which the number $x = 3$ lies strictly between the roots of $f(x) = x^2 - 6x + m = 0$.
questions.solution: For $x = 3$ to lie strictly between the roots, $f(3) < 0 \implies 3^2 - 2(3^2) + m < 0 \implies m < 9$, so largest integer is $8$.
questions.explanation: Apply location of roots on real axis techniques in Coordinate Geometry (Straight Lines & Circles) (Director Circle & Chord of Contact).
